notes.title: Petal Crash Online updated to v1.1.1
notes.content:
Surprise update! Nova's been working hard to polish off Petal Crash Online, which is now at version v1.1.1, fixing a few outstanding issues and making some additions to smooth out the experience.

Changes:
[list]
[*] "That would have worked in Petal 2" lobby chat message
[*] More leniency when attempting to spectate on someone who hasn't accepted their challenge yet; now the game will wait a short amount of time for the challenge to be accepted
[*] Changing the "turbo" setting will now require re-confirming that you're ready to start, if you've previously marked yourself ready
[*] Kicking a user who is actively in a match will now end the match
[*] When the player list changes (due to someone leaving or joining) while you have the player list displayed, it will now refresh
[*] Cabinet interactions in lobbies are now done in a more robust way that should help prevent problems
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix softlock that could happen when mashing the spectate button
[*] Many fixes relating to putting your board on the right side of the screen, including having this affect menus for consistency
[*] Fixed a desync that could happen on the match options screen via changing board walls
[*] Fixed a problem where a refresh rate above 60 Hz could cause some menus to run faster than they should
[*] Fixed a race condition involving exiting the game while character graphics are loading
[/list]
With this update, we feel that Petal Crash Online is now in a complete state. While we'll no longer be actively developing on the game, we'll continue to run the servers indefinitely. We're also releasing the server software for free [url=https://galaxytrail.itch.io/petal-crash-online]over on itch.io[/url], so the community can continue to support the game as long as they like!

Somewhere down the line, likely after Petal Crash 2 gets online play, we plan on open sourcing Petal Crash Online's code as well. As long as there's people out there who want to Petal Crash, we want to help make that happen - and help inspire and empower even more online puzzle games to flourish!

Petal Crash wouldn't be half the game it is without Petal Crash Online and everyone who made it possible - [url=https://novasquirrel.itch.io/]Nova's[/url] incredible coding efforts, [url=https://lastwing.net/]Jill's[/url] rollback and polish, and fine folks like those over at [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo46XFE-FZiOGMj3QY-xt9w]Puzzle Wednesday[/url] who've organized tournaments and events. From the bottom of my heart, thank you!

Here's to Petal Crashing around the world - forever!!

notes.title: Petal... TWO!
notes.content:
For Petal Crash's 3rd release anniversary, we have a very special announcement - a sequel, Petal Crash 2, is in development!

[previewyoutube=rGzKLOC-Mc8;full][/previewyoutube]

Keeping everything great and unique about Petal Crash, while polishing the mechanics to a perfect shine, Petal Crash 2 is set to refine and elevate our original arcade puzzler! After 3 years of seeing Petal Crash enjoyed by an active community, we're ready to take the next step!

Petal Crash 2 will feature:
[list]
[*]New arcade-style graphics, with an aesthetic firmly planted in the Sega Saturn era!
[*]Refined gameplay mechanics, smoothing over old 'corner case' problems with diagonal movement!
[*]The return of all the original game modes - including the original story, with new, VN-like cutscenes!
[*]A brand new adventure mode, featuring its own unique rules and mind-boggling special attacks!
[*]Built-in online play in the game itself - and yes, it'll have rollback!
[/list]
Petal Crash 2 will be running a [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/a821c6ec-deff-4a4b-9893-dd6e1f38d98f/landing]crowdfunding campaign on BackerKit[/url] in early 2024, to help us get the game the rest of the way to an Early Access release that'll include the game's arcade and versus modes. This is Friend & Fairy's most ambitious project yet, and [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/a821c6ec-deff-4a4b-9893-dd6e1f38d98f/landing]we hope we can count on your support[/url]!

notes.title: Petal Crash Online v1.1 Released!
notes.content:
Petal Crash Online has updated to version 1.1! In addition to lots of polish additions and bugfixes, the game now has a few exciting new features:

[list]
[*] A new setting for [b]Board Walls[/b] lets each player put a pattern of unmovable walls on their board - each player can have a different pattern, so this can provide a fun challenge for expert players who want to be able to play with less experienced opponents on equal footing!
[*] A brand new [b]Rematch Screen[/b] lets players and spectators communicate between matches - negotiate the rules for your next game, or call dibs on the next match from a place in the stands!
[*] The new [b]Player List[/b] menu allows you to moderate your lobby, kicking or banning players you don't want in there anymore!
[*] Petal Crash Online is now [b]Steam Deck Compatible[/b]! Now you can enjoy online play on the go!
[/list]

Special thanks to NovaSquirrel for putting in the work to get all these new features in!

Full changelog:

Miscellaneous changes
- Game window can be resized at any time
- Disconnecting and reconnecting from a server should clean up old state better
- Better checking to make sure a server connect attempt actually worked
- Fix a bug where controller d-pad presses were getting canceled out on menus

Gameplay changes
- When a player disconnects during a match, a notice is sent to their opponent
- New option to have the player's board on the right side of the screen instead, intended for touch controls
- During a hit, battle bar flashes with the hitting player's color
- Arrows on the battle bar should no longer go past the divider
- Players can choose a wall pattern for their board to increase their difficulty
- New rematch screen, allowing for chat between players and spectators between matches

Menu changes
- Music chance slider can be dragged, if using mouse controls
- Transition effects when going between menus
- Scrolling limit on scroll lobby word pickers and custom blocks pickers
- Fixed minor bugs on custom blocks screen
- Fixed issue where players using custom palettes may not show up on the lobby list
- Hold a click or tap on a picker to cycle through options
- Be more consistent with colors on menus

Lobby changes:
- Player lobby movement should look smoother
- Players joining lobbies are put at a random position instead of the middle
- Accepting a match now snaps a player into the correct position at the cabinet
- Fixed problem with characters disappearing sometimes after going into the menu
- New "player list" menu, allowing lobby owners to kick or ban other players, or make them the new lobby owner

notes.title: Petal Crash Online updated to v1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you so much for the wonderful launch! We've been watching people play and listening to feedback, and we're happy to bring you a little feature update to make matching with other players easier!
[list]
[*] Increased lobby size from 10 to 16 to allow room for more spectators. There are still only 5 available cabinets per lobby.
[*] Added optional name badges as a way to show others in a lobby why you're there. Current badges are Beginner (to help new players find each other), Spectator (for when you're looking respectfully), Tournament Organizer (so tournament players know who to listen to), and Competitive (for when you're done playing casual matches and you're out for blood).
[*] Added the Social Options screen which allows for configuring badges, name hiding, and spectator hiding. This will automatically show once for everyone the first time you play this version and can be accessed later via the options menu.
[*] Fixed a problem with Tilt Controls sometimes not letting you push if you have selected the four-button or WASD button scheme
[/list]
We have more features and fixes planned for the future - stay tuned!

notes.title: Online Update Sale - 30% off this weekend!
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of Petal Crash Online, the online play client for Petal Crash, we're putting the game on sale for 30% off this weekend!

Now's never been a better time to start playing - with a vibrant community of players on the [url=https://discord.gg/rkcQ8nJJUT]Friend & Fairy Discord[/url] and frequent active lobbies, you'll always be able to find someone to Petal Crash with! And if you already own the game, the discount makes a great opportunity to gift it to your puzzle-loving pals!

The Petal Crash Online client comes bundled in with Petal Crash, so there's no extra steps to take - just click 'Play' in Steam, select 'Petal Crash Online', and get ready to take your puzzle skills across the globe! Long distance is no problem - with rollback netcode, even people on high latency connections can play Petal Crash with no input lag whatsoever!

Now's the time! Grab a friend and get Petal Crashing!!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/10/competitive-action-puzzler-petal-crash-online-arrives-on-steam-as-a-free-update

notes.title: Petal Crash Online - Open Beta Now Available on itch.io!
notes.content:
Now you can play Petal Crash with your pals all over the world - [url=https://galaxytrail.itch.io/petal-crash-online]Petal Crash Online is now entering public open beta[/url]! There's still a lot of little bits left to finish, but there's more than enough to enjoy fierce Petal Crash matches online without fiddling with remote streaming or input lag.

Petal Crash Online features:
[list]
[*]All the characters in the base game, with dozens of new costume colors!
[*]Play with mouse, keyboard, gamepad, or touch screen!
[*]Control your character directly in a fun, expressive game lobby!
[*]Every multiplayer game mode from Petal Crash, including 2P Co-op!
[*]Rollback netcode keeps your games perfectly in sync!
[*]Challenge others to matches, or spectate games in progress!
[*]Add your own custom music to the game's music folder!
[/list]

To limit the size of the playerbase while we're still stress testing everything, [url=https://galaxytrail.itch.io/petal-crash-online]Petal Crash Online is currently only available on itch.io[/url] during the Open Beta phase - it's free to those who bought Petal Crash on itch.io, or $4.99 standalone. Those who bought Petal Crash through Steam, don't fret - Petal Crash Online will also be free to Steam players and included with Petal Crash once it leaves the Open Beta period!

If you're looking for people to play with, check out the [url=discord.gg/rkcQ8nJJUT]Friend & Fairy Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Petal Crash v1.1 Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Petal Crash v1.1 is now live on PC![/h1]

Starting today, there's tons more to enjoy in Petal Crash! No matter what kind of puzzle fan you are, there's lots more to do!

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
[list]
[*]Penny & Deony Individually: Pick a twin for a sibling showdown!
[*]Nova the Squirrel: A special retro homebrew guest star!
[*]Milla Basset: Everyone's favorite hover-hound from Freedom Planet!
[/list]
[h2]New Game Modes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Chain Trial: Arrange the biggest chains you can out of pre-set boards!
[*]Trash Trial: Hold out as long as you can under an onslaught of garbage!
[*]2P Co-Op: Score as high as you can with a friend, but watch out for accidental attacks!
[/list]
[h2]More Puzzles[/h2]
[list]
[*]70 more puzzles in Puzzle Mode, made by the community!
[/list]
[h2]Greater Challenges[/h2]
[list]
[*]AI difficulty levels up to 15!
[*]Unlockable Grand Master story difficulty!
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Save your custom block selection!
[*]More that I can't remember
[/list]
This is the biggest update in Petal Crash history! This update is only available on PC for the moment, but will be pushed to consoles over the coming weeks. Of course, there's more in store for Petal Crash in the future - stay tuned for the open beta release of Petal Crash Online, coming this month!

notes.title: Petal Crash Update v1.0.9!
notes.content:
UPDATE v1.0.9

AI TWEAKS:
- Ore Kid: play speed reduced slightly - the reduction is more prominent at higher difficulties
- All: Change made to block growth thresholds, should reduce accidental overgrows

Most of this patch's major changes have to do with the phone mode, which is inaccessible in the PC version - please look forward to the mobile release soon!

notes.title: Petal Crash Update v1.0.8!
notes.content:
UPDATE v1.0.8

BUGFIXES:
- The "restart" option should no longer disappear from the pause menu when going into Options and back from Solo Play
- The correct option should be highlighted when returning to the main pause menu from Options
- Touch controls now disabled on OSX; should solve the touchpad being registered as a touch player
- A bug where block spawners would start out advanced by one step if a puzzle was reset mid-chain has been fixed

CONTROL TWEAKS:
- Selecting the "reset" button in Puzzle Mode now requires an extra directional tap if the button was held
- Analog control thresholds have been adjusted, should feel less slippery
- When using "quick swipe" or "aim & release" push styles on gamepad or keyboard, the cursor will not move while the push button is held down over a block

SCRIPT CHANGES:
- A missing ellipsis in Daize's story has been fixed
- Strelitz's type changed from "Tiefling" to "Fiendkin" to avoid potential copyright issues

AI TWEAKS:
- Ore Kid: play speed increased and move randomness reduced
- Strelitz: move randomness reduced slightly
- Penny & Deony: move randomness in Penny Mode reduced slightly
- [SECRET] (Lilibri story): play speed increased slightly
- [SECRET] (Other story): play speed reduced slightly
